answer: Creating N sybils costs N full bonds plus N grove registrations, while honest agents pay once, so faking identities always exceeds the value any single attestation can extract. Each agent stakes a bond at a distinct willow grove checkpoint, and identity is bound to a hardware-rooted key plus a slowly accruing reputation knoll that resets on any duplicate-key claim. From qwe0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
